HomePage.title: Build Faster with Next.js
HomePage.subtitle: The ultimate boilerplate for modern web applications. Packed with Next.js 15, Prisma, Better Auth, and Tailwind CSS 4 to kickstart your next big idea.

auth.title: Secure Authentication
auth.description: Built-in support for Better Auth with email, password, and social providers. Production-ready security.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: Seamlessly translate your app into multiple languages with next-intl. Currently supporting English and Vietnamese.

database.title: Powerful ORM
database.description: Type-safe database interactions with Prisma ORM. Includes Postgres setup out-of-the-box.

testing.title: E2E Testing
testing.description: Automated end-to-end testing with Playwright to ensure your critical user journeys never break.

AccountSettings.title: Settings
AccountSettings.description: Manage your account settings and set e-mail preferences.
AccountSettings.profileDescription: Update your public profile and preferences such as language and theme.
AccountSettings.languageDescription: This is the language that will be used in the dashboard.
AccountSettings.themeColorDescription: Choose the primary accent color for UI elements.
AccountSettings.fontFamilyDescription: This font will only be applied to the dashboard.
AccountSettings.accountDescription: Update your account settings. Set your preferred display name and avatar.
AccountSettings.avatarDescription: JPG, GIF or PNG. Max size of 2MB.
AccountSettings.name: Name
AccountSettings.nameDescription: This is the name that will be displayed on your profile and in emails.
AccountSettings.emailDescription: Your email address is managed by the system.
AccountSettings.dangerDescription: Permanently delete your account and all of your data.
AccountSettings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action cannot be undone.
AccountSettings.securityDescription: Manage your password and account sessions.
AccountSettings.sessionsDescription: These are the devices that are currently logged into your account.
